item.description:

item.description:

item.title: The search for a top dark matter candidate
item.description:
📝 Scientists at Italy’s Gran Sasso National Laboratory are working to confirm September’s potential dark matter detection. One primary target has been weakly interacting massive particles, or WIMPs—a hypothesized candidate for dark matter that passes through normal matter with barely a trace. Maybe, just maybe, it was dark matter.
🔗 Read more: https://www.smithsonianmag.com/science-nature/the-search-for-a-top-dark-matter-candidate-was-losing-hope-then-came-a-potential-signal-will-it-be-enough-to-energize-the-struggling-field-180989923/
